simple.meaning: כָּלָה (kâlâh) appears 205 times in the Hebrew Scriptures and is introduced in connection with kingship.
simple.biblicalBackground: The first appearances are in Genesis, Exodus, Leviticus, Numbers, Deuteronomy, and 9 more, beginning at Genesis 2:1. BibleIQ detects the main surrounding context as birth, family, family line, kingship.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to כָּלָה (H3615) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: People in Scripture are understood by their place in the story. BibleIQ follows כָּלָה through the actual verses so the reader sees the person in context instead of as an isolated dictionary entry.
simple.summary: כָּלָה (kâlâh) / H3615 is tracked through Genesis 2:1, Genesis 2:2, Genesis 6:16, Genesis 17:22. The entry is generated from source alignment, occurrence evidence, and the surrounding Scripture context.
